[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]We recognize the significance of hospital services, the need for efficient equipment and the requirement of safe and reliable system usage for the patients, hence we deliver, commission and install medical systems with the help of trained and experienced engineering team who are certified and qualified to perform installation, commissioning and auditing of your equipment. Goring Medical employ, a team of qualified personnel who are skilled to install equipment assuring complete accuracy, quality, and safety. Hence, we are a one-stop solution for medical installations for all OEM medical equipment manufacturers.

Once delivered, installed, and approved by our expert engineers, the equipment is certified for RPA and trust sign off before being used clinically. Also, we ensure that all the approvals and relevant documentation are completed before the project is closed.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
